originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&__gdp_695` is never used.

sanitizedDescription: The value written to `&gdp` is never used.
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 0301ffab3d9.c (ext2fs). Identical alarm to TRANSFORMATION_79 — 'Value stored to gdp is never read' at line 8 ('gdp = "group_desc"' inside #ifdef EXT2FS_ENABLE_SWAPFS). 'gdp' IS used at line 10 ('printf("%c\n", (*gdp)++)'). Same desugaring artifact as T79: when __need___FILE=true, the stdio.h desugaring places 'printf' inside 'if(!__need___FILE){...}', making 'gdp' appear as a dead store (assigned at line 8 but the read at line 10 is unreachable when __need___FILE=true). The presence condition __need___FILE=true AND EXT2FS_ENABLE_SWAPFS=true is the same non-standard/artifact configuration identified in T79.
